name: Orshom Brong

facts.text: Level 80, 30,000 health, linked with Orylle. Takes no damage except Cold damage.
Spawns Orshom's Fire; at 50% health he draws the room onto himself.
That he swallowed the hall's hearth-fire is Living Server writing built on the cold-only immunity.

story: Orshom Brong was the biggest of the thrawn ogres who followed Orylle up from the seams, and on the night Krondon fell he put his face into the great hearth of the deepest hall and drank the fire. The ogres tell it as a boast. Whatever happened, he has burned inside ever since, and no flame or blade troubles him now. Only cold reaches what is left of him. He stands at the queen's shoulder and fights when she fights, and when he is half spent the fire in him flares, he roars, and the whole room turns to him.
legend: Nothing hurts him but cold. Bring ice wizards, cold-damage casters, anything frosty, and put them on him and only him. At half health he pulls the room; healers be ready. He and Orylle go down together or the raid goes down.

aggro: Fire in me! Fire in all of me!

phases.text: The hearth wakes! Come closer, little cold ones!

death: Cold... so cold... the fire goes out...

lairEntry: The great hearth is dark. Something beside it glows.

phases.text: Orshom's fire flares. The room turns to him!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Krondon's hearth-fire is out. Orshom Brong is dead.

loremasterTopic.text: He drank the hearth-fire of Krondon's deepest hall, the ogres boast, and has burned within ever since. Fire and steel are nothing to him. Only cold. He stands beside Orylle; they fall together.
